latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of **smart-web-components-usage** skill.
- Provides comprehensive usage guides and API references for all components in the @ht-smart/basic library.
- Supports common integration, configuration, and usage questions for components such as HtProTable, HtForm, HtModal, HtDrawer, HtDict, HtCard, HtCascader, HtSelect, HtList, HtNiceModal, HtTree, HtDevicePlayer, HtFileUpload, HtFloatButton, HtLayout, and more.
- Includes component quick index, core usage tips, code examples, and links to advanced API documentation.
- Enables quick lookup and best practices for enterprise-level tables, advanced forms, modal/dialog usage, dictionary bindings, advanced trees, and selection components.
